node_definition.done_when: Declared domain review checks join the checklist mechanism REVIEW_ITEMS already uses in reckon/crew/review.py, not a seventh scored dimension: REVIEW_DIMENSIONS, the acceptance floor in reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py and the prompt falsifier stay unchanged. A review of a node the checks apply to, read through rules_for in reckon/crew/domain_rules.py, carries one verdict line per matching check, composed where the review prompt's subject is built (reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py); a record that omits one parses as incomplete and names the check. A failed check is stored as a finding with a blocking severity, so review_lifecycle's existing derivation sees it with no change to reckon/crew/review_lifecycle.py. New tests in tests/test_a_review_answers_the_domain_checks.py pass: the composed review prompt for a fixture node lists exactly the checks that match it; a fixture record with every verdict parses complete, and one missing a verdict parses incomplete naming the check; a failed check is stored with a blocking severity and lifecycle() reports the run open; a project without declarations scores six dimensions with no checklist lines and the acceptance floor is unchanged, which is the control. The gate log shows the new tests failing on the base commit. Gate, run in place on the fleet allocation with its log under the run directory: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_a_review_answers_the_domain_checks.py tests/test_domain_rules.py tests/test_domain_rules_reach_the_brief.py tests/test_call_sites_is_a_checklist_item.py tests/test_health_review_parses.py tests/test_skipped_record_reaches_the_checklist.py tests/test_a_review_waits_for_its_repair.py tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py, judged by failure delta against the base revision, with baseline_suite and after_suite recorded as flat manifest records whose logs name their revision, tree and command on the first line and end with their EXIT line; ruff check and ruff format --check clean on the changed paths.
